title: A `step:<slug>` cite in a record or PR body resolves to a step on the roadmap branch
why: A record can cite a step that was never filed, so the cite points at nothing and the gap has no tracked home.
note: Filed by triage, 03:58 CST Nov 9. Incident: docs/decisions/act-in-place.md:14 on #2024 and #2293 named `step:qform-wrapper-flags`, and #2311 carried it, but no step record existed until triage filed it at 03:57 CST (lane notes-fix-page asked). Candidate home: the lane lint, which reads each `step:<slug>` in the changed records and the PR body and refuses one with no roadmap/data/steps/<slug>.json on origin/roadmap.
